The invitation repository provides a persistence pattern. Member removal should auto-withdraw offers. If either side leaves while an offer is open, it is withdrawn automatically. Withdrawn offers map to the "canceled" status. Auto-withdrawn offers likely follow the same path. Offers expire exactly seven days after creation. They remain actionable until then and are treated as expired afterward.

Lapsed offers are not open. Accepting or declining them throws an expired error. Withdrawing a lapsed offer likely returns nothing_pending, since no offer is currently pending.

The spec only throws "expired" for accepted or declined lapsed offers. It does not mention withdrawal. A lapsed offer might remain in the database as pending while being logically expired, or its status could be updated to expired.

The acceptor will be the event actor. No role change event fires for the acceptor if they already hold owner. The previous owner only loses their role if they still hold it at acceptance time.
